scraped_sources.title: Prague
scraped_sources.description: Capital and largest city of the Czech Republic
scraped_sources.extract: Prague is the capital and largest city of the Czech Republic and the historical capital of Bohemia. Located on the Vltava River, the city has a population of about 1.4 million, making it the twelfth-largest city in the European Union. Its metropolitan area is home to approximately 2.3 million people.

scraped_sources.title: Georg Baresch
scraped_sources.extract: Georg Baresch, was a Bohemian antique collector and alchemist from Prague known for his connection to the Voynich manuscript.

scraped_sources.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
scraped_sources.description: Japanese manga series by Hiromu Arakawa
scraped_sources.extract: Fullmetal Alchemist  is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hiromu Arakawa. It was serialized in Square Enix's shōnen manga anthology magazine Monthly Shōnen Gangan between July 2001 and June 2010; the publisher later collected the individual chapters in 27 tankōbon volumes. Set in a fictional universe in which alchemy is a widely practiced science, the series follows the journey of two alchemist brothers, Edward and Alphonse Elric, as they search for the philosopher's stone to restore their bodies after a failed attempt to bring their mother back to life via alchemy. The steampunk world of Fullmetal Alchemist is primarily styled after the European Industrial Revolution.
